$comment: Copy to aiv.local.json (gitignored) and keep only what you need. Every key is optional. docs/ENVIRONMENT.md explains each one. librarySeeds maps a sample-library id to the absolute path of a local checkout at the commit a video pins (for example "vsco2-ce": "<absolute path of your VSCO-2-CE checkout>"); aiv doctor --fix then copies pinned files from it instead of downloading them.
